period_note: Full balance sheet + P&L, cumulative Jan 1 - Mar 31 2026 (genuine Q1 filing). Consolidated basis (Mutual Trust Bank PLC-Solo, incl. Off-shore Banking & Islamic Banking windows, and subsidiaries MTB Securities PLC + MTB Capital Limited). Fetched as an unscoped bonus extension of this session's MTB backfill (beyond the original 2013-2018 gap list), since MTB's site already had this filing live and it was a CLEAN TEXT PDF (203 lines via pdftotext -layout, no OCR/visual-reading needed) -- lowest-risk possible extraction. SCHEMA NOTE: MTB's balance sheet now separately reports a 'Bond' total (BDT 8,100m at Mar-2026) that breaks into 'Perpetual Bond' (BDT 4,000m, unchanged from Dec-2025) + 'Subordinated Debts' (BDT 4,100m, down from Dec-2025's 4,850m) -- this did not exist as a separate breakout in earlier years. The combined Bond total is stored in 'subordinated_debt' (consistent with how the already-stored 2025_Q3.json apparently handled the same breakout, confirmed via its own balance-sheet-identity reconciliation: 50,221+343,309+61,278+9,550=464,358 vs its stored total_liabilities 464,357), and 'perpetual_bond' is added as a new supplementary line item for transparency. VALIDATION: Total Liabilities + Total Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest (487,427,129,752+30,182,395,414+137,682=517,609,662,848) reproduces Total Property and Assets EXACTLY. Total Liabilities itself reconciles exactly from components: Borrowing(44,420,146,361) + Bond(8,100,000,000) + Deposits(374,596,494,791) + Other Liabilities(60,310,488,600) = 487,427,129,752. P&L chain exact throughout: Net Interest Income(484,666,470) + Total Other Income(4,606,632,582) = Total Operating Income(5,091,299,052) exactly; - Total Operating Expense(3,047,271,251) = 2,044,027,801 = Profit Before Provision exactly; - Total Provision(1,128,038,827) = 915,988,974 = Profit Before Tax exactly; - Provision for Taxation (Current Tax 287,489,156 less Deferred Tax credit 252,103,835 = 35,385,321) = 880,603,653 = Net Profit After Tax exactly.
